# liboqs / fuzz_test_sig_stfl_xmss

liboqs's own fuzz target `fuzz_test_sig_stfl_xmss` ([source](source/fuzz_test_sig_stfl_xmss.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over liboqs (open-quantum-safe/liboqs at 8979276a).

OQS_SIG_STFL_verify on KAT pk/signature/message for XMSS-SHA2_10_256 or XMSSMT-SHA2_20/2_256 with pk, then sig, then msg overwritten by fuzz bytes; verify result ignored.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against liboqs at commit 8979276a.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing. Its halts statements say only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer. Its agreement statements say only that the code never crashes or trips a sanitizer, and allow a run that never ends. Its bound statements say only how often its builds may disagree. Its decidability statements say only that some program decides where its builds agree.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch liboqs` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_test_sig_stfl_xmss.plain` | 60,640 | `debc9f8567bc6cf1dcd16901a0b1e28346e5afc3a53f819e2c309e39f51aadf3` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_test_sig_stfl_xmss.ubsan` | 60,800 | `04c9502186c5336fa8912fa0966510ba63fc0bbd26289be5d47bd76a38a953d1` |
| asan | `fuzz_test_sig_stfl_xmss.asan` | 581,112 | `d91f7384cfa4d3ce662d6c533972ab849575494cc6ac722731a316609ca78881` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_test_sig_stfl_xmss.asan-ubsan` | 580,696 | `54299acb3de735de1c700d55017ba2446c47a85860752999ef105e6bc82f5d44` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
